verdict.rationale: Keycloak's docs provide OIDC/OAuth2 discovery endpoints, client registration with redirect URIs (PKCE-compatible), token introspection/revocation for refresh and access tokens, and client-credentials/device flows, all abstracted behind standard endpoints so developers don't hand-roll protocol logic. Community evidence corroborates real-world production use securing multiple apps via SSO/OIDC over years, though one comment notes the learning curve if unfamiliar with OAuth/OIDC concepts. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation/example specifically calling out PKCE flow configuration steps and refresh-token rotation behavior in the evidence pack.
